import { Group } from 'three/webgpu';

// Sample: mesh-mode product showcase loaded from a Hunyuan3D / Trellis-2 GLB.
// renderMode='mesh'. Generated per spec §9.C L347-L353 mesh sub-prompt:
// load GLB via ctx.glbLoader, do NOT override its textures with imageUrl.

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const group = new Group();
  group.name = 'node:' + config.nodeId;
  group.userData.handlers = {};

  let loadedScene = null;
  ctx.glbLoader.load(config.meshUrl, (gltf) => {
    loadedScene = gltf.scene;
    group.add(loadedScene);
  });

  for (const primitive of config.cinematicPrimitives ?? []) {
    ctx.primitives[primitive.name](group, primitive.params);
  }

  for (const text of config.textContent ?? []) {
    if (!text || !text.text) continue;
    const t = ctx.fontAtlas.createText({
      text: text.text,
      size: text.typography?.fontSize ?? 20,
    });
    group.add(t);
  }

  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    if (loadedScene) {
      loadedScene.traverse((obj) => {
        if (obj.geometry && obj.geometry.dispose) obj.geometry.dispose();
        if (obj.material && obj.material.dispose) obj.material.dispose();
      });
    }
  };

  return group;
}
